segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אַרְבָּעָה דְּבָרִים פָּטְרוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה: מְבִיאִין עֵצִים מִכׇּל מָקוֹם, וּפְטוּרִין מֵרְחִיצַת יָדַיִם, וּמִדְּמַאי, וּמִלְּעָרֵב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The Sages «exempted» a soldier «in» a military «camp» in «four matters: One may bring wood» for kindling «from any place» with no concern that he is stealing wood from its owners; «and one is exempt from» ritual «washing» of the «hands» before eating; «and» one is exempt «from» the separation of tithes from «doubtfully tithed produce [demai],» i.e., produce purchased from an am ha’aretz, one who is not diligent in separating tithes; «and» one is exempt «from establishing an eiruv.»

positions.claim: a camp may take wood anywhere, and is exempt from hand-washing, demai and eiruv
